text:
marta_s: Heads-up — Velvette procurement returned our MSA + DPA with inline redlines. They also want an explicit POC/SoW clause in the order form and net-60 payment terms. They said legal needs signature routing by EOD Friday or they pause procurement.

ana_r: Can you paste the main redlines here? especially anything around data residency / liability or SLA changes.

marta_s: Main asks (copied):
- Add 60d net payment
- Add a POC SoW attachment with acceptance criteria and a 30-day trial period
- Increase indemnity carveouts for customer-supplied data processors
- Change DPA to require logging retention of 3 years
They also circled an SLA uptime of 99.95% and want credits in weeks, not % of invoice.

kevin_l: Thanks. Quick takes:
- Net-60 is fine to accept for this enterprise but need sign-off from finance on exposure.
- 3 years logging retention in DPA is borderline; need scoping language (only logs necessary for security incidents).
- SLA credits: we should keep standard SLA credit formula; can offer a cap and a one-time service credit for POC failures.
- Indemnity: cannot expand unlimitedly. Propose explicit carveouts for third-party infra and gross negligence only.

sam_t: From POC perspective we can scope this as: 2-week pilot, up to 50k tokens/day, dedicated model variant with telemetry, acceptance criteria: (1) avg p99 latency < 200ms, (2) mean generation quality pass-rate >= 85% on their eval set. I can draft the SoW snippet.

ana_r: Please paste the SoW snippet and I'll slot it into the order form. Also need final pricing for the trial — will we discount?

sam_t: SoW snippet:```
POC SCOPE: Redwood to deliver a 2-week proof-of-concept (POC) with a single model variant. Redwood will provide access to a dedicated inference pool and telemetry hooks. Acceptance criteria: p99 latency <200ms; generation pass-rate >=85% on customer-provided eval set. If acceptance criteria met, POC converts to paid pilot under order form terms. Any overage tokens billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates.```

marta_s: Pricing: propose fixed pilot fee $18,000 for the 2-week POC (covers reserved capacity + eng support). If they require further guarantees, escalate pricing.

kevin_l: I'll prepare counters for the MSA/DPA. Proposed DPA tweak language: limit log retention to "logs strictly necessary for security incident investigation" and add a mutual audit window. For liability, cap at 2x fees paid in prior 12 months for the POC/pilot.

ana_r: I've drafted an order form patch. Snippet:```
ORDER FORM - POC
Customer: Velvette Health
POC TERM: 14 days
Fee: $18,000 flat
Payment Term: Net 60 (Customer request)
Acceptance: See attached SoW
Signature routing: Redwood AE -> Sales Ops -> Legal -> Customer signatory
```

ops-bot: :rotating_light: signature-request created (DocuSign) id=doc_9472, routing: marta_s -> ana_r -> kevin_l -> customer-sign

marta_s: I routed it and pinged Velvette procurement/contact (we have approval from buyer). They asked to see SOC2 Type II report and the standard DPA counters.

kevin_l: I'll attach the SOC2 redaction guidance and our counter redlines in the doc. Expect a tidy counter by EOD. If finance objects to net-60 exposure, flag here and I'll hold on final sign-off.

ana_r: Finance says net-60 for this pilot is acceptable up to $25k exposure, so we're good.

sam_t: One operational note: for the POC to meet latency criteria we need the dedicated instance provisioned in us-west-2 and GPU priority. I'll file a capacity request after signature.

marta_s: Thanks team. Action items: Kevin - post counters in this thread; Ana - update DocuSign envelope with counters once Kevin posts; Sam - standby to submit capacity request after signed; I'll keep Velvette procurement looped.

kevin_l: Posted counter redlines in the doc and added the liability cap language.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: envelope updated with new version id=doc_9472_v2

marta_s: Velvette replied — they accepted the SoW wording but pushed back on the liability cap. They've asked for VP-level escalation to approve a higher cap.

ana_r: Looping in @ceo_steph for escalation as requested by the customer (internal note: cc legal and finance).

kevin_l: I'll prepare an exec summary of exposure and recommended approval threshold.

marta_s: Great — if we can get VP sign-off by tomorrow AM we can keep the signature timeline. Otherwise they may move to an alternative vendor.

ops-bot: :email: reminder scheduled for 12 hours to @ceo_steph and execs.
